title: Fault-injection tests of reliability models on ROS 2 control architectures: code and raw data
description: Code, frozen protocols, SHA-256 hashes, raw data and post-hoc analyses for a study that injects process-kill faults into six ROS 2 control architectures and compares observed time to loss of function and simulated cell production with exact Markov chain predictions. Faults are emulated software crashes at accelerated rates; the work cell is simulated, without contact physics or a PLC. Code is under the MIT license and data under CC BY 4.0.
notes: Carried out within project 6-25-4, Universidad Tecnológica de Pereira. No external funding.
